gen-mystery-quest-gf-ruda: Mystery Quest leaves a gap in every curve, bookish and nostalgic. Ruda is a plain sans that looks bent from a single wire, and its sizable x-height keeps pages of text smooth on screen.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-sarpanch: Storybook charm up top, with every curve left open. Mystery Quest supplies the nostalgic heading while Sarpanch, a sans-serif with a clearly open lowercase e, takes over the text without fuss.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-schibsted-grotesk: Schibsted Grotesk draws big open a and e shapes with tall bowls beneath the compact, nostalgic ascenders of Mystery Quest. Openness runs through both, since neither font closes its curves in.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-sintony: Mystery Quest is bookish and nostalgic, every curve left open. Sintony, a sans-serif with a chunky, tall midzone, stays smooth when its size is modest, since no curve clogs.
gen-eater-gf-noto-sans-syriac: Eater snarls, dark and aggressive, with hairlines that are present but never razor thin. Noto Sans Syriac meets it with tall, bulb-like lowercase bowls and wide, easy s turns, so the two feel friendly against menace.
gen-flavors-gf-noto-sans-syloti-nagri: Flavors is whimsical and commanding, drawing every stroke at a single thickness, while Noto Sans Syloti Nagri stands tall in the lowercase. A tall, confident lowercase is the thing they share.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-noto-sans-tamil-sup: Round, open-parenthesis curves and a tall middle band make this body text read stocky and contemporary. Noto Sans Tamil Supplement handles the steady reading, while Autour One, constant as bent wire, brings the bold expression.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-vend-sans: Paprika is loud and scattered, its lowercase filling the line like capitals. Vend Sans, a plain sans with curves that never thin at the turns, anchors everything with a steady, constant-width line.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-sulphur-point: Expressive Revalia spreads wide, with a g whose lower curve stays open and short stalks over a tall band. Sulphur Point, a sans with a marker-like line, keeps its thickness around every curve.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-yaldevi: Yaldevi reads plainly, its e opening clearly to the right and its lowercase running large against the stencil bridges of Snowburst One. Paragraph after paragraph would go down smoothly, with no snags.
